description: This file defines the BankTransaction class and related functions for handling bank transaction processing, including allocation, reconciliation, and payment entry management within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: BankTransaction
classes.description: Class for managing bank transaction records, including allocation, reconciliation, and status updates.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Calculates unallocated amount after a new bank transaction is inserted.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions when a bank transaction is submitted, such as clearing linked payment entries and setting status.

methods.name: on_update_after_submit
methods.description: Updates allocations and status after the transaction is updated post-submission.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of the transaction, clearing linked payment entries.

methods.name: update_allocations
methods.description: Calculates and updates allocated and unallocated amounts, and sets status accordingly.

methods.name: clear_linked_payment_entries
methods.description: Clears linked payment entries based on their document type.

methods.name: clear_simple_entry
methods.description: Clears a simple payment entry, setting its clearance date.

methods.name: clear_sales_invoice
methods.description: Clears a sales invoice payment's clearance date.
